sentence: This project studies how a potassium channel protein in lysosomes is regulated and how the channel contributes to lysosomal function and neurodegenerative diseases.
This project builds methods that map the regulatory protein factors that bind to DNA in single cells to understand gene regulation in cancer cells.
This project tries to induce immune tolerance for treating food allergy using platelet-targeted gene and cell therapy.
This project collects detailed information about opioid use and misuse in research participants to understand how genetic influences shape it.
This project builds a noninvasive system that forecasts seizures in people with epilepsy.
This project studies how nerve signals control stem cells during corneal wound healing through interactions with Schwann cells.
This project develops a method to improve transplantation of endothelial cells by using exogenous mitochondria to restore small blood vessels.
This project studies how the order of infection with different flaviviruses affects the immune response and outcome of infections.
This project builds a model that uses chest CT examinations and electronic medical record data to predict atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease.
This project develops lipid nanoparticles that carry therapeutic nucleic acids past mucus and cellular barriers to correct mutations in cystic fibrosis.
This project uses patch-clamp electrophysiology and fluorescence lifetime imaging microscopy to explain how environmental signals control the gating process of ion channels.
This project combines biomechanics and regenerative biology to regenerate, repair or replace tissues that serve a mechanical function.
This project builds a technology that studies genetic interactions in vivo in mouse models instead of one gene at a time.
This project builds a model that finds women with a higher risk of HIV and tests whether a clinical decision support platform can use it.
This project studies the molecular mechanisms behind systemic lupus erythematosus and measures inflammatory cell death pathways using biomarkers.
This project tests in a randomized clinical trial how sodium–glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors affect coronary microvascular dysfunction and endothelial dysfunction.
This project uses fruit flies to find out how metabolism changes as stem cells divide and how brain dopamine and stress affect them.
This project studies the cross-reactivity of myelin specific T cells in the blood and cerebrospinal fluid of patients with multiple sclerosis.
This project edits glycans to find out what glycans do in cell signaling and cell differentiation.
This project studies how myonuclear turnover works in skeletal muscle at rest, with age or in response to exercise.
